simple.meaning: יָשָׁר (yâshâr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “straight (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 119 times across Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 10 more, beginning at Exodus 15:26. Its contexts include family, commandment, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָשָׁר (H3477).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: יָשָׁר (yâshâr) / H3477 is traced through Exodus 15:26, Numbers 23:10, Deuteronomy 6:18, Deuteronomy 12:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: convenient, equity, Jasher, just, meet(-est), pleased well right(-eous), straight, (most) upright(-ly, -ness).
definitions.full: H3477. yashar יָשָׁר adjective straight, right ; — ׳י 1Sam 29:6 70t.; construct יְשַׁר Prov 29:27 ; feminine יְשָׁרָה Ezek 1:7 4 t.; plural יְשָׁרִים Num 23:10 31t.; construct יִשְׁרֵי Psa 7:11 8 t.; feminine יְשָׁרוֺת Ezek 1:23 (strike out Co); — 1 straight, level , of a way Isa 26:7 ; Jer 31:9 ; Psa 107:7 ; Ezra 8:21 ; foot Ezek 1:7 ; wings 1:23 (? see above) 2 right, pleasing: a. to God , בעיני הַיָּשָׁר that which is right, pleasing in the eyes of, agreeable to (either construct before ׳י , or with suffixes referring to him), especially in Deuteronomic writers, Exod 15:26 (R), Deut 12:25 ; Deuteronomy 13:19; 21:9 ; 1Kin 11:33 , 38 ; 14:8 ; 15:5 , 11 ; 22:43 2Chr 20:32 , 2Kin 10:30 ; 12:3 ; 14:3 ; 15:3 , 34 ; 16:2 ; 18:3 ; 22:3 2Chr 24:2 ; 25:2 ; 26:4 ; 27:2 ; 28:1 ; 29:2 ; 34:2 ; Jer 34:15 ; י בעיני והטוב ׳הישׁר Deut 6:18 ; י בעיני והישׁר ׳הטוב 12:28 ; 2Chr 14:1 ; י לפני והאמת והישׁר ׳הטוב 31:20 . b. to man , בעיני (ה)ישׁר Deut 12:8 ; Judg 17:6 ; 21:25 ; 2Sam 19:7 ; Jer 40:5 ; Prov 12:15 ; 21:2 ; בעיני ו(ה)ישׁר (ה)טוב Josh 9:25 (D), Jer 26:14 ; 40:4 ; לִפְנֵיאִֿישׁ יָשָׁר דֶּרֶךְ יֵשׁ Prov 14:12 there is a way which is pleasing before a man = 16:25 . 3 straightforward, just upright: a. of God , הוא וְיָשָׁר צַדִּיק Deut 32:4 (song); י וישׁר ׳טוב Psa 25:8 ; י ׳ישׁר Psalm 92:16; his ways Hosea 14:10; his משׁפטים Neh 9:13 ; Psa 119:137 ; מִּקּוּדִים 19:9 ; דָּבָר 33:4 ; the words of divine wisdom Prov 8:9 . b. of man , God made him upright Eccl 7:29 ; but אָ֑יִן בָּאָדָם יָשָׁר Micah 7:2 an upright man among men there is none and yet Job is וְיָשָׁר תָּם Job 1:1 (see Da), 1:8 ; 2:3 , compare Psa 37:37 ; וישׁר זַךְ Job 8:6 ; so earlier of David as an uprightman 1Sam 29:6 ; of man's doings || זַךְ Prov 20:11 , compare 21:8 ; of his way of life || טובה 1Sam 12:23 ; יְשַׁרדֶּֿרֶךְ Prov 29:27 ; יִשְׁרֵיּדֶֿרֶךְ Psa 37:14 ; of his heart, mind, and will, לֵבָב יִשְׁרֵי upright of heart 2Chr 29:34 ; יִשְׁרֵילֵֿב Psa 7:11 ; 11:2 ; 32:11 ; 36:11 ; Psalm 64:11; 94:15 ; 97:11 ; בְּלִבּוֺתָם יְשָׁרִים 125:4 . c. as a noun , (1) with reference to things, הֶעֱוֵיתִי יָשָׁר the right I have perverted Job 33:27 ; יְעַקֵּ֑שׁוּ הַיְשָׁרָה Micah 3:9 pervert the right (literally twist that which is straight ); יְשָׁרִים דֹּבֵר speaketh right things Prov 16:13 , compare 2Kin 10:15 . (2) more commonly of men, in singular (ה)יָשָׁר Micah 2:7 ; 7:4 ; 2Kin 10:3 ; Prov 21:29 ; Job 23:7 ; collective, Psa 11:7 ; also in הַיָּשָׁר סֵפֶר book of the upright Josh 10:13 ; 2Sam 1:18 (compare 1Kin 8:53 ᵐ5 ; Dr Intr. 182 ), a collection of ancient national poetry; in plural יְשָׁרִים the upright , of pious Israel Num 23:10 (song E); elsewhere of the upright among the people of God as distinguished from the wicked, in Wisdom Literature. Job 4:7 ; 17:8 ; Prov 2:7 , 21 ; 3:32 ; 11:3 , 6 , 11 ; 12:6 ; 14:9 , 11 ; 15:8 , 19 ; 16:17 ; 21:18 ; 28:10 ; 29:10 , in late Psa 33:1 ; 49:15 ; 107:42 ; 111:1 ; 112:2 ; 112:4 ; Psalm 140:14 and Dan 11:17 . 4 abstract, uprightness , וְיָשָׁר בֶּאֱמֶת Psa 111:8 (Thes), but read rather ישֶׁר with Hi Ri Bae, after ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 Jerome.
